create_NGramRepeatBlock: create an NGramRepeatBlock instance with a specified ngram size to prevent repetition in beam search
run_NGramRepeatBlock_forward: run the NGramRepeatBlock forward pass to penalize repeated ngrams in token likelihood probabilities
test_is_cuda_extension_usable: test whether the ngram_repeat_block CUDA extension is built and usable on the current device
review_NGramRepeatBlock_no_repeat_ngram: review the _no_repeat_ngram method that bans tokens forming repeated n-grams by setting their lprobs to negative infinity
refactor_NGramRepeatBlock_call_cuda_exte: refactor the call_cuda_extension method to invoke the ngram_repeat_block CUDA forward function for accelerated ngram blocking
